body.label: Effect
body.html: Create a 2-unit psychic barrier within 4 units. It grants cover until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase one barrier size, Defense bonus, or forced-movement reduction from this card by 1.
Remove one Physical damage Condition from yourself or an ally affected by this card.

rider.title: BARRIER — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, extend the barrier by 1 unit.
